messages:
maya chen: Intake: bringing up seraphim-8b-v1 for prod eval. Need a quant plan + calibration dataset. Goals: ~3x cost reduction vs fp16, p50 latency ~ <90ms, quality drop <10% on instruction evals. Repo: https://models.internal/seraphim-8b (private)
sam patel: fyi what's the fp16 baseline metrics and eval harness? also any fine-tune/qlora quirks we should know about?
maya chen: baseline fp16 p50 ~75ms on a8g, cost ~0.012/token in current infra. Instruction eval suite is the usual core-instr-2k + multi-turn safety set. model was qlora-adapted last month; no special fused ops.
liam nguyen: propose calibration plan:
- calib set: 2k mixed instr/long-context samples (keep 10% long tail >1024)
- runs: symmetric per-channel int8, layerwise fp8 (e4m3), and gguf exported variants
- smoke run command:
```
python infra/calibrate.py \
  --model seraphim-8b \
  --dtype int8 \
  --calib-file data/calib/seraphim_2k.jsonl \
  --out-dir /tmp/calib-seraphim-int8
```
start with int8 symmetric; if perf or regression is bad, fallback to fp8/gguf.
rachel ortiz: watch tokenizer compatibility for gguf exports — tokenization drift causes embedding mismatches. add embedding drift checks and ppl delta in smoke.
sam patel: checklist for rollout metrics (canary): ppl delta, answer-similarity (EM/F1 or BLEU depending), embedding cosine to baseline, latency p50/p95, OOM/errors, memory footprint. fallback policy: auto-failover to fp16 variant on >3% production regressions in key metrics.
maya chen: prioritization: 1) int8 symmetric quick sweep (2k, 3 seeds), 2) gguf fp8 hybrid if int8 fails, 3) quant-aware ops patch if we see attention kernel issues.
- quick smoke checklist (short):
  - run 200-sample smoke from core-instr
  - compare embedding cosine >= 0.985
  - ensure ppl delta <= 6%
  - no OOMs on 2x batch
  - latency p50 increase <= 25%
calib-bot: queued calibration job cb-482 for seraphim-8b (int8, 2k) :gear:
liam nguyen: thresholds to gate rollout: max quality drop 6% relative on instruction suite, embedding drift <=1.5% (cosine), tokenization mismatch = 0, memory < baseline*0.65 for cost wins.
rachel ortiz: I'll own the eval harness and run the 2k sweep tomorrow AM. if anyone changes weights or tokenizer, please ping me and update model sha.
maya chen: thanks — tagging @sam for canary policy confirmation and @liam for calibration infra. I'll follow up with canary percentages and alerting hooks.
sam patel: got it, will add canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 24h with regression alerts. if any metric crosses threshold rollback immediate.
liam nguyen: note: include a perf trace capture for any p95 > 400ms so runtime team can inspect kernel selection.
maya chen: perfect. will post results in this thread when cb-482 finishes.
calib-bot: job cb-482 finished: int8 pass=partial, metrics uploaded to /artifacts/cb-482/summary.json :white_check_mark:
